Always use a deep link so the OS returns them to the app automatically or processes Confirmed purchases upon FetchProducts when you initialize the game as shown on the infographic.\"}],\"level\":1,\"listItem\":\"bullet\",\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"178a59525c0b\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"4fcb0723cf3f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Wrong environment:\"},{\"_key\":\"920e8187365b\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" developing against the production environment risks breaking live features.
